dedupe_keys.name: dataset of high temperature extremes over major land areas of the belt and road during 1979 2018

description: Yang and Zhang publish high-temperature-extreme indicators over major Belt and Road land areas for 1979 to 2018. The series counts hot days, hot nights and combined events under several stated minimum and maximum temperature thresholds, using a 0.5-degree daily CPC input grid. Science Data Bank shows a public CC0 release with 19 files totalling 142.36 MB; the article identifies NetCDF format. The repository metadata are available without charge, and no account was needed to inspect them. Infrastructure simulations can use the threshold series to construct historical heat scenarios for electricity demand, health-service pressure or building exposure. The product does not include asset capacities, local urban heat amplification or future projections. Its half-degree source grid may miss street-level extremes; file dimensions and individual coverage were not verified because no archive was downloaded. The article reports validation against eastern-China station data, which should not be treated as validation for every region. This hazard layer complements other weather observations, not replacing local measurements.
